{"CommandLine":"
# Root cause confirmed: pawns runs in bridge network mode
# Container registers its private IP 172.17.x.x, Pawns server expects the public IP
# Fix: restart pawns-cli with --network=host so it sees the real public IP directly

docker stop pawns-cli && docker rm pawns-cli
echo "---Restarting with host network---"
docker run -d \
  --name pawns-cli \
  --network=host \
  --restart=unless-stopped \
  iproyal/pawns-cli:latest \
  -email=adityashirsatrao007@gmail.com \
  -password=Aditya@001 \
  -device-name=LUNA_LINUX \
  -accept-tos

echo "---Waiting 15s then checking logs---"
sleep 15
docker logs pawns-cli --tail 15","Cwd":"/home/aditya","WaitMsBeforeAsync":25000,"toolAction":"Restarting Pawns with host network","toolSummary":"Fix Pawns inactive status"}
